name: Suzuki Airi
source:
Madly in love with Kei, she is an exchange student from the United States. She is actually completely Caucasian, cursed with weeaboo parents. Her mother is a lawyer and her father is a cop. She chose Hokkaido for her exchange rather than Honshu to spite her parents' attempts to live vicariously through her.

Favorite Color: Lilac
Blood Type: AB-

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/midnightsprings/apocalyptic-dream-18-otome-in-zombie-apocalypse/description]Kickstarter[/url]]
